bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity brought traffic to a standstill, and the office should monitor repair works.

Chennai is rapidly emerging as a leading digital growth hub and the next data centre capital of India.

The Global Startup Summit 2026 will bring founders and investors together in Chennai on November 14 at Holiday Inn OMR.
